description_for_human: Checkout, licensing and settlement API for software — local wallets, cards and PayPal through one integration.
description_for_model: Create hosted checkouts, poll settlement status, manage merchant catalog and licensing. Register a merchant with wavepay_register or POST /v2/register — no key needed to register.

auth.instructions: Registration is unsigned. Merchant calls carry x-wavepay-service-key: mk_live_… — minted by POST /v2/register.
